title: Proof Broker refinement record (spec v1.0 §6.3)
description: A structured description of an adapter's translation choices when refining an IR document into backend-native input. The lifting phase consumes the refinement record (in reverse) to lift backend proofs back through the adapter's translation. Soundness obligation: every adapter decision affecting goal form must be recorded; un-recordable decisions are unsound.

specializations.description: Ordered list of translation decisions made by the adapter. Inversion processes them in reverse order during lifting.

fragment.description: Logic fragment the adapter targeted (e.g. 'LIA', 'LRA', 'FOL', 'HOL'). Fragment ids drawn from the registry.

auxiliary.description: Adapter-specific auxiliary data (e.g. SMT-LIB script header, TPTP role assignments). Opaque to the broker; consulted only by the originating adapter's inversion logic.

source.description: Pre-specialization form (a type-id, symbol-id, or other reference depending on kind).

justification.description: Reference to metadata or registry tag that justified the decision (e.g. 'embeds_into:Int_for_universal_LIA').

soundness_witness.description: Reference to a verified embedding lemma or instance proof in library_provenance. Required for type_specialization, method_specialization, axiomatization.
